problems.title: Opposite nonzero roots have zero sum and negative product
problems.question: Find a so x²-(a²-16)x+3a+6=0 has equal-magnitude roots of opposite signs.
steps: The sum condition gives a=±4.
At a=4 the product is positive; at a=-4 it is -6.
Only a=-4 gives two real roots ±√6.

problems.title: A squared difference misses a cross term
problems.question: If t=x/4-7/x, express x²/16+49/x² using t.
steps: The cross term is 7/2, with x≠0.
Add it back.

problems.title: A sine-rule ratio and a side sum
problems.question: A=30°,B=45° and AC+BC=18(1+√2). Find BC.
problems.idea: The sides follow their opposite sines.
steps: Thus AC=√2BC.
The side sum is BC(1+√2), so BC=18.

problems.title: A right trapezoid built around a right triangle
problems.question: A right trapezoid’s smaller diagonal is perpendicular to the slanted leg and has length 15. Its acute angle α has cosα=4/5. Find perimeter.
problems.idea: The diagonal and slanted leg form a right triangle with the larger base as hypotenuse.
steps: The slanted leg is 25cosα=20 and height 20sinα=12.
The smaller base is the other horizontal projection of the diagonal: √(15²-12²)=9.
The perimeter is 25+20+12+9=66.

problems.title: Choose the correct work-time model
problems.question: Two workers together finish in 12 days. Worker 1 doing half a job, followed by worker 2 doing one third, takes 20 days. Which system finds their individual whole-job times x,y?
problems.idea: Together rates add; sequential times add.
steps: A worker needing x days for a whole job needs x/2 for half. The other needs y/3 for one third.
Thus the displayed system is the correct model, with positive x,y.
It permits (x,y)=(24,24) and (20,30); both satisfy the data.

problems.title: A radius ratio yields a sine sum
problems.question: In a right triangle, circumradius:inradius=5:2. Find the sum of sines of its acute angles.
problems.idea: The two sines sum to the leg sum divided by the hypotenuse.
steps: c/(a+b-c)=5/2 gives 2c=5(a+b)-5c.
Thus (a+b)/c=7/5.

problems.title: Root squares in Vieta form
problems.question: Distinct roots a,b of x²-px+q=0 satisfy a²+b²=1. Find the necessary relation between p,q.
steps: Set this equal to 1.

problems.title: A cyclic trapezoid transfers a diagonal
problems.question: In trapezoid ABCD, AD=5. The circumcircle of ABC meets the larger base AD again at M, with AMB=60°,MB=3. Find CD.
problems.idea: AMBC is an isosceles cyclic trapezoid.
steps: The equal diagonal lengths and base angles follow from the cyclic trapezoid’s symmetry.
In triangle ACD, the cosine rule gives CD²=5²+3²-2·5·3cos60°=19.

problems.title: A proposed tangent-cotangent identity has the wrong reciprocal
problems.question: Which listed formula is not an identity for acute α?
steps: Where t≠1 the expression equals -tanα, not the printed -cotα.
At α=45° the displayed fraction is undefined as well.
The other listed formulas are standard Pythagorean or reciprocal identities.
problems.answer: The formula equating that fraction to -cotα (choice d).

problems.title: The incenter’s ratio along a bisector
problems.question: AB=6,BC=5,AC=9. AD is a bisector and I the incenter. Find AI:ID.
problems.idea: The ratio equals the adjacent-side sum divided by the opposite side.
steps: One derivation assigns vertex weights BC,AC,AB to the incenter; the weight at D is AC+AB.
Thus AI/ID=(6+9)/5=3.

problems.title: Bisector length from two sides and the included angle
problems.question: AB=1,AC=2,A=120°. Find AD, the A-bisector.

problems.title: Do not count a vanishing quadratic coefficient as a root
problems.question: Find a so ax²-2ax+3=0 has exactly one real root.
steps: At a=0 the equation is 3=0 and has no root.
A nonzero quadratic has exactly one distinct real root when its discriminant vanishes, giving a=3.

problems.title: A quadratic in x squared
problems.question: Find the product of the real roots of x⁴+x²-12=0.
problems.idea: Factor using x² as one variable.
steps: The real roots are ±√3.
Their product is -3; x²+4 has no real roots.

problems.title: Sum and product recover four ordered pairs
problems.question: Count real solutions of x²+y²=29,xy=10.
steps: For x+y=7, the numbers are 2,5 in either order.
For x+y=-7, they are -2,-5 in either order.
The four pairs are distinct.

problems.title: Add three exact trigonometric values
problems.question: Evaluate tan30°+sin60°+cos45°.
steps: Putting the sum over 2√3 gives numerator 2+3+√6.

problems.title: An equation for reciprocal roots
problems.question: ax²+bx+c=0 has distinct roots x₁,x₂. Which equation has roots 1/x₁,1/x₂?
problems.idea: Substitute x=1/t and multiply by t².
steps: The reciprocals require x₁,x₂≠0, equivalent to c≠0.
Under that restriction the substitution preserves both roots.
problems.note: If c=0 one original root is zero and its reciprocal does not exist. Distinctness alone does not exclude that case.

problems.title: A strictly positive sum has no zero
problems.question: Count real roots of x²+3|x|+10=0.
steps: The full left side is at least 10, so cannot vanish.

problems.title: Acuteness bounds the third side
problems.question: A triangle has sides 10,19,x and is acute; x is not its largest side. Which listed x can work?
steps: Among 10,12,14,15,17,8, only 17 lies in that range.
The sides 10,17,19 satisfy the triangle inequalities and the acute square inequality.

problems.title: Cancel through sine and cosine
problems.question: Simplify cosβ tanβ/sin²β-cosβ/tanβ.
problems.idea: Write tangent as sine divided by cosine.
steps: Their difference is (1-cos²β)/sinβ=sin²β/sinβ=sinβ.
The original domain requires sinβ≠0 and cosβ≠0.

problems.title: Reciprocal squared roots
problems.question: a,b are roots of x²+5x+2=0. Find 1/a²+1/b².
steps: The numerator is 25-4=21 and denominator 4.

problems.title: Speed is numerically 24 greater than travel time
problems.question: A bus covers 432 km. Its speed in km/h is 24 greater than its travel time in hours. Find its speed.
steps: The positive time is 12 hours, giving speed 36.

problems.title: Add two binary numbers
problems.question: Compute 10011₂+101101₂.
problems.idea: Convert or add by carrying base 2.
steps: The sum is 64=2⁶.
Its binary form is 1 followed by six zeros.

problems.title: Two identical quadratics appear
problems.question: Find the product of roots of (x-1)(x+19)+x²+18x-19=0.
steps: The equation is 2(x-1)(x+19)=0.
Roots 1,-19 have product -19.

problems.title: A median fixes the two bisector-adjacent sides
problems.question: AM=√31 is a median, CL=2 and MB=3, where AL is a bisector. Find AL.
problems.idea: Use BC=6,BL=4 and the angle-bisector ratio.
steps: Write AC=t,AB=2t. Then 31=(10t²-36)/4, giving t=4.
Thus AC=4,AB=8.
The bisector identity gives AL²=AB·AC-BL·LC=32-8=24.

problems.title: The parallelogram law relates side and diagonal differences
problems.question: A parallelogram’s side difference is 3 and diagonal difference 2. The larger side equals the smaller diagonal. Find the diagonal sum.
problems.idea: Use a for the smaller side.
formulas: Sides a,a+3; diagonals a+3,a+5; diagonal-square sum=twice side-square sum.
steps: (a+3)²+(a+5)²=2a²+2(a+3)² simplifies to a²-2a-8=0.
The positive root is a=4.
The diagonals are 7 and 9.
